project_context.intent: Redesign layout for maximum density and minimal vertical scrolling (Cryptobase style), keeping all existing KPIs, metrics, and exact color palette.

layouts.dashboard_container: h-screen w-full bg-slate-50 flex flex-col p-2 md:p-3 overflow-hidden
layouts.header: flex-none h-12 md:h-14 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-md shadow-sm mb-3 px-4 flex items-center justify-between
layouts.main_grid: flex-1 grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-12 gap-3 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto xl:overflow-hidden
layouts.left_panel: xl:col-span-8 2xl:col-span-9 flex flex-col gap-3 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto pr-0 xl:pr-1
layouts.right_panel: xl:col-span-4 2xl:col-span-3 flex flex-col gap-3 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto xl:border-l xl:border-slate-200 xl:pl-3
layouts.metrics_ribbon: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-7 gap-2 flex-none
layouts.main_charts_grid: grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-2 gap-3 flex-1 min-h-[250px] md:min-h-[300px]

cards.general: Use shadcn Card. Override padding to `p-2` or `p-3` (e.g., `<CardContent className='p-3'>`). Reduce border radius to `rounded-md` and use `shadow-sm`.
cards.status_tiles: Extremely compact, flex-row items-center gap-2, col-span-1 in the metrics_ribbon.
cards.kpi_cards: Compact flex-col or flex-row. Value, sparkline, and trend badge must fit tightly. col-span-1 in the metrics_ribbon.
cards.indicateur_cards: Placed in the right_panel. Ensure the inline input ('montant en litige') is visible without wrapping awkwardly. Use compact form fields.

charts.projections: Set parent container height to `h-32` or `h-36`. Use Recharts ResponsiveContainer. Minimal axes.
charts.main_charts: Set parent container to `h-full`. Recharts margin: { top: 5, right: 5, bottom: 0, left: -20 }. Tick fonts text-[10px]. Hide vertical grid lines.
charts.general: Do not change calculations or content. Just reduce visual whitespace.

ai_section.chat: Make the chat area scrollable (`overflow-y-auto`) and occupy remaining vertical space (`flex-1`) in the right panel.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use subtle 1px borders (border-slate-200) instead of heavy shadows for separation.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Add subtle background shifts (e.g., hover:bg-slate-50) to clickable cards like the Indicateurs.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: HARD CONSTRAINT: DO NOT change existing colors. Use exactly #063044, #0E9488, #F8A942, #B45309, #808080, #10B981, #EF4444.
HARD CONSTRAINT: DO NOT change KPI contents, logic, or metrics.
Maximize horizontal space. The Left Panel handles 7 small top-row metrics, 4 small projection charts, and 2 larger main charts.
The Right Panel acts as a fixed sidebar for the 3 Indicateurs, AI Variance, and AI Chat, maximizing vertical utility.
Remove large paddings (gap-6, p-6). Replace with gap-2/gap-3 and p-2/p-3 to achieve the dense 'Cryptobase' aesthetic.
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='period-selector'`).
Ensure layout is responsive: stacks on mobile, multi-column strictly on xl/2xl viewports.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on containers having content underneath. All Cards must be bg-white.
